# (e.g. t1_a440_2s.wav .. t5_a880_2s.wav, long_10s.wav). Adjust paths per host.
# After running, read `getAudioEvents` for transition gaps (B-037) and dup-ended (B-036).
call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t1_a440_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t2_c554_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t3_e659_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t5_a880_2s.wav startIndex=0
inspect
# let auto-advance run, then inspect events
pause
resume
next
inspect
prev
inspect
# one-shot then restore
play /home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/long_10s.wav
inspect
next
inspect
# missing file skip
call ext.nothingness.setQueue paths=/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t1_a440_2s.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/DOES_NOT_EXIST.wav,/home/user/src/nothingness/.tmp/t3_e659_2s.wav startIndex=0
inspect
call ext.nothingness.getAudioEvents
call ext.nothingness.getDiagnostics
